responsibility: Defines the FreeBSD-specific Alpha target configuration layered on top of the generic Alpha and ELF headers. It customizes preprocessor and linker specs for FreeBSD, including POSIX CPP handling and the dynamic-linker/shared-vs-static link command fragments, fixes ABI-visible type settings such as wchar_t size to match the FreeBSD system headers, marks the target as ELF, disables init-section assumptions, and adjusts backend defaults such as profiling GP requirements and the default struct-return convention for compatibility with FreeBSD runtimes and older releases.
